prerequisites.reason: Understanding neurons is necessary to understand how artificial neural networks are constructed and function.
Autoencoders are a specific type of neural network, so understanding artificial neural networks is necessary first.
Computational graphs in this course context are used to represent neural network computations, so understanding neural networks is necessary before studying them in depth.
Training techniques are applied to neural network models, so understanding the models is necessary before learning how to optimize them.
Visual recognition with machine learning commonly relies on neural network models, so understanding artificial neural networks is necessary first.
Training techniques depend on data being available and understood, making datasets necessary before learning model training in practice.
Learning algorithms operate on data, so understanding datasets is necessary before learning how algorithms train and predict.
Understanding how data is structured and formatted is necessary before working with datasets.
Training techniques are specific methods for optimizing models within the broader framework of learning algorithms.
